Package org.frc5411.lib.schema

Interface Singleton<Type>

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Cloneable, Closeable, Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
OdometryThread<Registrable>
All Known Implementing Classes:
CTREOdometryThread, REVOdometryThread, Subsystem
public interface Singleton<@NonNull Type> extends Serializable, Closeable, Cloneable

Singleton

Represents a un-enforced singleton instance, which is Serializable, and Closeable, additionally, this class should define a serialVersionUID that differentiates this object from other objects which have been serialized into a ObjectInputStream.

Though not strictly enforced by this interface, a Singleton should define an accessor #getInstance() to statically retrieve the instance of a singleton type.
